gloss: to drown, to be addicted to

definitions.explanation: To be submerged in water and unable to breathe.

definitions.gloss: to be addicted to, to indulge in
definitions.explanation: To be excessively devoted to something.

examples.japanese: {川|かわ}で{溺|おぼ}れそうになった。
examples.english: I almost drowned in the river.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}が{溺|おぼ}れている！
{海|うみ}で{泳|およ}いでいた{男性|だんせい}が{溺|おぼ}れて{救助|きゅうじょ}された。
examples.english: A man who was swimming in the ocean nearly drowned and was rescued.

examples.japanese: ゲームに{溺|おぼ}れる{若者|わかもの}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: More and more young people are becoming addicted to games.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{成功|せいこう}に{溺|おぼ}れて、{周|まわ}りの{人|ひと}の{意見|いけん}を{聞|き}かなくなった。
examples.english: He became intoxicated with success and stopped listening to the opinions of those around him.

notes:
{溺|おぼ}れる means to drown (literally) or to be addicted (figuratively).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)

ASPECT (ている):
{溺|おぼ}れている indicates someone is currently drowning (needs help!) or is in a state of addiction.

MEANINGS:
1. Physical: to drown, to be drowning
2. Figurative: to be addicted to, to indulge in

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {川|かわ}で{溺|おぼ}れる: to drown in a river
- {溺|おぼ}れそうになる: to almost drown
- 〜に{溺|おぼ}れる: to be addicted to ~ (figurative)

FIGURATIVE EXPRESSIONS:
- {酒|さけ}に{溺|おぼ}れる: to be addicted to alcohol
- {愛|あい}に{溺|おぼ}れる: to be madly in love
- {快楽|かいらく}に{溺|おぼ}れる: to indulge in pleasure

COMPOUNDS:
- {溺|おぼ}れ{死|し}ぬ: to drown to death
- {溺|でき}{愛|あい}: excessive love, doting
